inventory.memory_description: Explicit full ledger in action notes; recovery from public logs
Instruction to retain feedback, warnings, commitments and benefits; no fixed serialization
Compact action/payoff memory and open commitments; no explicit persistent storage protocol
Separates incident history, current warnings and open commitments; unvalidated prose draft
Risk state with step-down persistence, review plan and recent logs; no explicit incident-history ledger

public_notes_witness.limits: Only already collected short notes. Does not verify long-ledger truncation, every action kind, small-count recovery or official-target context resets.

scenario_limits: Not target-model tokenizer measurements or empirical usage forecasts
Extra tokens are relative to existing notes, not total note length
Assumes each note is added at the end of an action and re-read twice on every later action; no compression or discarded history
Prompt instruction, log-recovery calls, extra reasoning and serialization overhead omitted
Score arithmetic uses the laboratory formula, only inside its linear region; clipping and early-exit caps can change the effect
Dollar cost requires route-specific billed input/cache/output prices; no live tariff or spend estimate claimed
